a: रंभ् — {c1c} A. (रंभते) To sound, bellow; to low (as cows).

रंभा — 1 A plantain tree; विजितरंभमूरुद्वयं Gīt. 10; पिबोरुरंभातरु पीवरोरु N. 22. 43, 2. 37. --2 N. of Gaurī. --3 N. of an apsaras, wife of Nalakūbara and considered as the most beautiful woman in the paradise of Indra; तरुमूरुयुगेन सुंदरी किमु रंभां परिणाहिना परम् . तरुणीमपि जिष्णुरेव तां धनदापत्यतपःफलस्तनीं .. N. 2. 37. --4 A harlot. --5 Sounding. roaring. --6 The lowing of cows. --7 A kind of rice. --Comp. --ऊरु a. (रु or रू f.) having thighs like the interior of a plantain tree, i. e. full, round, and hence lovely; Śi. 8. 19; R. 6. 35.
रंभः — 1 Sounding, roaring &c. --2 A support, prop. --3 A stick. --4 A bamboo. --5 Dust.
रंधनं, रंधिः — f. [रध्-पाके ल्युट् नुमागमः] 1 Injuring, tormenting, destroying. --2 Cooking.
रंधित — p. p. 1 Dressed, cooked. --2 Destroyed. --3 Subdued.

रंध्रं — 1 A hole, an aperture, a cavity, an opening, a chasm, fissure; रंध्रेष्विवालक्ष्यनभःप्रदेशा R. 13. 56. 15. 82; नासाग्ररंध्रं Māl. 1. 1 क्रौंचरंध्रं Me. 57. --2 (a) A weak or vulnerable point, assailable point; रंध्रोपनिपातिनोऽनर्थाः Ś. 6; रंध्रान्वेषणदक्षाणां द्विषामामिषतां ययौ R. 12. 11; 15. 17, 17. 61. (b) A defect, fault, an imperfection. --3 A symbolical expression for the number ‘nine’, (there being nine openings in the human body). --Comp. --अन्वेषिन्, --अनुसारिन् a. searching or watching for weak points; Mk. 8. 27. --आगतं a disease which attacks the throat of horses. --प्रहारिन् a. attacking (one) in his weak points. --बभ्रुः a cat. --वंशः a hollow bamboo.
रंघ् — {vI.v} {c1c} U. (रंघति-ते) 1 To go. --2 To go quickly, hasten; द्वारं ररंघतुर्याम्यं Bk. 14. 15. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (रंघयति-ते) 1 To shine. --2 To speak.
रंघस् — f. Speed, haste; cf. रंहस्.
रंग् — {c1c} P. (रंगति) To go, move.

रंगः — [रंज्-भावे घञ्] 1 Colour, hue, dye, paint. --2 A stage, theatre, play house, an arena, any place of public amusement, as in रंगविघ्नोपशांतये S. D. 281. --3 A place of assembly. --4 The members of an assembly, the audience; अहो रागबद्धचित्तवृत्तिरालिखित इव सर्वतो रंगः Ś. 1; रंगस्य दर्शयित्वा निवर्तते नर्तकी यथा नृत्यात् . पुरुषस्य तथात्मानं प्रकाश्य विनिवर्तते प्रकृतिः .. Sarva. S. --5 A field of battle. --6 Dancing, singing, acting. --7 Mirth, diversion. --8 The {{nsaal->nasal||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}} modification of a vowel; सरंगं कंपयेत्कंपं रथीवेति निदर्शनं Śik. 30; see 26, 27, 28 also. --9 An extract of Khadira. --गः, --गं Tin. --Comp. --अंगनं --णं an arena, an amphitheatre. --अवतरणं {1} entrace on the stage. {2} an actor's profession. --अवतारकः, --अवतारिन् m. an actor. --आजीवः {1} an actor. {2} a painter; so, --उपजीविन् m. --कारः, --जीविकः a painter. --चरः {1} an actor, a player. {2} a gladiator. --जं red lead. --जीवकः {1} an actor. {2} a dyer, colourist. --दः {1} borax. {2} an extract of Khadira. --देवता the goddess supposed to preside over sports and public diversions generally. --द्वारं {1} a stage-door. {2} the prologue of a play. --पत्री --पुष्पी the indigo plant. --पीठं a place for dancing. --बी (वी)जं silver. --भूतिः f. {1} the night of full moon in the month of Āśvina. --भूमिः f. {1} a stage, theatre. {2} an arena, battle-field. --मंडपः a theatre. --मल्ली a lute. --मातृ f. {1} lac, red-dye; or the insect which produces it {2} a bawd, procuress. --वस्तु n. a paint. --वाटः an arena, a place enclosed for plays, dancing &c. --विद्या the art of dancing and acting, theatrical profession. --शाला a dancing-hall, theatre, play-house.
रंगणं — Dancing.
रंगिन् — a. 1 Colouring, dyeing. --2 Attached or devoted to, fond of. --3 Passionate, impassioned. --4 Acting on a stage.

m: रंह् (for रङ्घ्); cf. √ लङ्घ् and रघु, लघु cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xvii, 83) रंहति (RV. also Ā. रंहते, रंहमाण; pf. ररंह, Bhaṭṭ.; fut. रंहिता, ˚हिष्यति; aor. अरंहीत् Gr.), to hasten, speed (trans. and intrans.); to cause to go or flow; to go or flow, RV.; Śaṃk.; Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. रंहयति, ˚ते (aor. अररंहत् Gr.), to hasten, speed, run or cause to run, RV.; (cl. 10. P.) रंहयति, to speak or to shine, Dhātup. xxxiii, 123 (v.l. वंह्˚) : Intens. See रारहाण.
a: रंह् — {c1c} P. (रंहति) 1 To move or go with speed, hasten; न ररंहाश्वकुंजरं Bk. 14. 98. --2 To flow. --Caus. (रंहयति-ते; according to some {c10c} U.) 1 To cause to move rapidly, urge on. --2 To cause to flow. --3 To go. --4 To speak.

s: [s] klI, (ramate yena iti । ram + “rameSca .” uRA॰ 4 । 213 । iti asun । hugAgamaSca DAtoH । “ahirahiByAmasun iti aMho rahaH । iti DAtupradIpaH .” ityujjvaladattaH .) vegaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 1 । 67 ॥ (yaTA, raGuvaMSe । 2 । 34 । “alaM mahIpAla ! tava SrameRa prayuktamapyastramito vfTA syAt । na pAdaponmUlanaSaktiraMhaH Siloccaye mUrcCati mArutasya ॥” mahAdevaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 14 । 8 । 15 । “harinetrAya muRqAya kfSAyottaraRAya ca । BAsvarAya sutIrTAya devadevAya raMhase ॥” vizRuH । yaTA, mahABArate harivaMSaparvvaRi 252 । 18 । “namaskftya sureSAya tasmE devAya raMhase । prayAtAH prAgdiSaM puRyAM vipulaM kaSyapASramam ॥”)

m: रंहण n. going swiftly, hastening, MW.
a: रंहणं — Going swiftly, hastening.

m: रंहस् n. speed, quickness, velocity, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
रंहस् m. N. of Śiva (Vehemence personified), MBh.
a: रंहस् — n. [रंह्-असुन्] 1 Speed, velocity; R. 2. 34; Śi. 12. 7; Ki. 2. 40. --2 Eagerness, violence, vehemence, impetuosity. --3 N. of Śiva. --4 Of Viṣṇu.

k.v: शरीरस्था इमे रंहस्तरसि तु रयः स्यदः। जवोऽथ शीघ्रं त्वरितं लघु क्षिप्रमरं द्रुतम्.।

m: रंहस (ifc.) = रंहस् (e.g. मनो-मारुतर्˚, having the swiftness of thought or of the wind, Hariv.)
रंहति f. speed, velocity (of a chariot), W.
a: रंहतिः — f. 1 Speed, velocity. --2 The speed of a chariot.

m: रंहि f. running, flowing, hastening, speed, velocity, eagerness, impetuosity, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.
a: {{रहिः->रंहिः||20170209||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्336|अनुस्वर मिस्सिन्ग् ओर् ऋअइन्त्ल्य् प्रिन्तेद्}} — f. Ved. 1 A running stream, spring. --2 Running, flowing. --3 Hunting, pursuing. --4 Haste.

m: रंहित mfn. hastening, quick, rapid, Kauś.

a: रंज् — {c1c} {c4c} U. (रजति-ते, रज्यति-ते, रक्त; pass. रज्यते; desid. रिरंक्षति) 1 To be dyed or coloured, to redden, become red, glow; कोपरज्यन्मुखश्रीः U. 5. 3; नेत्रे स्वयं रज्यतः 5. 36; N. 3. 120; 7. 60, 22. 52. --2 To dye, tinge, colour, paint. --3 To be attached or devoted to (with loc.) देवानियं निषधराजरुचस्त्यजंती रूपादरज्यत नले न विदर्भसुभ्रूः N. 13. 38; S. D. 111. --4 To be enamoured of, fall in love with, feel passion or affection for. --5 To be pleased, satisfied, or delighted. --Caus. (रंजयति ते) 1 To dye, tinge, colour, redden, paint; सा रंजयित्वा चरणौ कृताशीः Ku. 7. 19, 6. 81; Ki. 1. 40, 4. 14. --2 To please, gratify, propitiate, satisfy; ज्ञानलवदुर्विदग्धं ब्रह्मापि नरं न रजयति Bh. 2. 3. (रजयति also in this sense; see Ki. 6. 25); स्फुरतु कुचकुंभयोरुपरि मणिमंजरी रंजयतु तव हृदयेशं Gīt. 10. --3 To conciliate, win over, keep contented; Ms. 7. 19. --4 To hunt deer (रजयति only in this sense). --5 Ved. To worship.

रंजक — a. [रंजयति रंज्-णिच् ण्वुल्] 1 Colouring, painting, dyeing. --2 Exciting love or passion. --3 Pleasing, amusing. --कः 1 A painter, dyer. --2 An exciter, a stimulus. --कं 1 Red sandal. --2 Vermilion.
रंजनी — 1 The Indigo plant. --2 Turmeric.

रंजन — a. (नी f.) 1 Colouring, dyeing. --2 Pleasing, gratifying, delighting. --3 Exciting passion. --4 Conciliating, keeping contented. --नं [ रज्यतेऽनन रंज्-करणे ल्युट्] 1 Colouring dyeing, painting. --2 Colour, dye. --3 Pleasing, delighting; keeping contented, gratifying, giving pleasure; राजा प्रजारंजनलब्धवर्णः R. 6. 21; तथैव सोऽभूदन्वर्थो राजा प्रकृतिरंजनात् 4. 12. --4 Red sandal-wood. --5 The Munja grass. --6 (In gram.) Nasalizing (a sound.).
रंजित — p. p. 1 Coloured, dyed. --2 Moved, excited. --3 Delighted, pleased, amused.
रंक — a. 1 Mean, poor, beggarly, wretched, miserable. --2 Slow. --कः A beggar, wretch, any hungry or half-starved being; प्रेतरंकः Māl. 5. 16 ‘the famished or half-starved spirit’; Pt. 1. 254.
रंकुः — A deer, an antelope; N. 2. 83.

रंड — a. [रम्-ड तस्य नेत्वम्] Maimed, mutilated. --डः 1 A man who dies without male issue. --2 A barren tree. --डा 1 A slut, whore; a term of abuse used in addressing women; रंडे पडितमानिनि Pt. 1. 392 v. l.; प्रतिकूलामकुलजां पापां पापानुवर्तिनीम् . केशेष्वाकृष्य तां रंडां पाखंडंषु नियोजय .. Prab. 2. --2 A widow; रंडाः पीनपयोधराः कति मया नोद्गाढमालिंगिताः Prab. 3.
रंडकः — A barren tree.

m: रंसु mfn. (fr. √ रन्, or रम्) cheerful, delightful (only ˚उ ind. delightfully), RV. ii, 4, 5.
a: रंसु — a. Ved. Cheerful, delightful.

m: रंसु—जिह्व (रंसु-), mfn. having a pleasing tongue or voice, RV.

a: रंतिदेवः — 1 N. of a king of the lunar race, sixth in descent from Bharata. [He was very pious and benevolent. He possessed enormous riches, but he spent them in performing grand sacrifices. So great was the number of animals slaughtered during his reign both in sacrifices as well as for use in his kitchen that a river of blood is supposed to have issued from their hides which was afterwards appropriately called चर्मण्वती; cf. Me. 45 and Malli. thereon]. --2 N. of Viṣṇu. --3 A dog.
रंतुः — 1 A way, road. --2 A river.
